# MyWorld

> MyWorld is a Creative IDE for writers and worldbuilders building fictional universes.
> It is a web application powered by Google Gemini AI, available at https://myworldhistory.site/

## What MyWorld Does

MyWorld is an all-in-one creative writing platform designed for fiction writers, worldbuilders,
lore creators, and fanfic writers. It combines an intelligent editor with AI-powered tools that
understand your fictional universe and help you maintain consistency across your stories.

## Core Tools

- **El Arquitecto (The Architect)**: An AI writing assistant that knows your world's canon.
  Offers panels for character notes, world patches, maps, lore, and settings.

- **La Forja de Almas (The Soul Forge)**: Entity management system that scans your files and
  organizes characters, creatures, and flora into three tiers:
  - Ecos (Echoes): mentioned characters without a profile yet
  - Limbos (Limbo): entities flagged for profile creation
  - Anclas (Anchors): fully profiled entities that anchor your universe

- **El Director (The Director)**: A Socratic AI that asks questions to help you develop your
  narrative, characters, and plot structure.

- **El Nexus (The Nexus)**: An interactive knowledge graph that visualizes entities and their
  relationships across your fictional world.

- **Guardián del Cánon (Canon Guardian)**: Real-time consistency checker that detects
  contradictions, character drift, and logic fractures as you write.

- **Tribunal Literario (Literary Tribunal)**: Three independent AI judges — the Architect
  (structure), the Bard (emotion), and the Hater (brutal critique) — score and analyze your writing.

- **Laboratorio de Ideas (Idea Lab)**: A chat interface that indexes your resource files and
  lets you discuss, develop, and crystallize ideas into your project.

- **La Imprenta (The Press)**: Compiles your project into a publication-ready PDF with cover,
  table of contents, and public authorship certificates.

- **Radar de Cánon (Canon Radar)**: Audits your entire project for cross-file paradoxes and
  narrative inconsistencies.

## Target Users

- Fiction writers (short stories, novels, series)
- Worldbuilders creating fictional universes, magic systems, and lore
- Fanfic writers building on existing universes
- Game designers creating narrative settings (TTRPG, video games)
- Screenwriters developing characters and story bibles

## Languages & Markets

- Primary: Spanish (LATAM), English (US)
- Secondary: Japanese

## Technology

- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- AI: Google Gemini (gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-1.5-pro)
- Backend: Firebase Functions (Node.js)
- Storage: Google Drive (user files), Firestore (metadata)
- Authentication: Google OAuth

## Key Differentiators

1. **Universe-aware AI**: The AI always has context from your canon files — it doesn't just
   write generic prose, it writes IN your world.
2. **Canon enforcement**: The guardian system actively prevents plot holes and character
   inconsistencies.
3. **Manuscript export**: Full publishing pipeline from raw markdown to formatted PDF with
   public authorship certificate.
4. **No lock-in**: Your files live in Google Drive. MyWorld reads and writes to your Drive;
   you own everything.
